# Text to Handwriting Converter — Multi-Script Document Generator

> A high-performance, client-side digital utility that transforms typed text into organic, realistic handwritten notebook pages with native multi-script support for Arabic right-to-left cursive, Hindi Devanagari, Russian Cyrillic, and Latin alphabets.

## Project Overview

- **Canonical URL**: https://ahmedelazabdev.github.io/Texttohandwriting/
- **Author**: Ahmed Elazab
- **Primary Technology**: HTML5 Canvas 2D API, Native Client-side JavaScript
- **Supported Languages**: Global multilingual coverage including Arabic, English, Hindi, Russian, Spanish, French, German, Urdu, Persian, and all Unicode-compliant scripts.

## Core Capabilities & Typographic Engine

1. **Native Script & Direction Detection**:
   - Automatic detection of Right-to-Left (RTL) scripts (Arabic, Persian, Urdu, Hebrew) vs. Left-to-Right (LTR) scripts.
   - Preserves contextual Arabic ligatures and glyph connections.
   - Dynamic vertical margin alignment: margin rule automatically moves to the right side of the page for RTL languages, and to the left for LTR languages.
   - Native rendering of Hindi Devanagari conjuncts and continuous Shirorekha headstrokes.

2. **Procedural Realistic Stationery**:
   - College Lined Paper (horizontal ruled lines with pink/red margin rule).
   - Yellow Legal Pad (warm drafting paper for professional notes).
   - Math / Engineering Grid Paper (graph sheets for STEM equations).
   - Plain White Sheet (unlined stationery for correspondence).

3. **Human Imperfection Modeling**:
   - Baseline vertical drift simulation to avoid machine-straight line alignment.
   - Micro-rotational angular jitter ($\pm 0.4^\circ$) per word.
   - Ink pressure gradient simulation for Ballpoint Blue, Gel Black, Fountain Indigo, Pencil Graphite, and Red ink.

4. **Export & Printing**:
   - One-click high-resolution PNG image download (800 × 1130 px A4/Letter aspect ratio).
   - Clean physical print support via custom `@media print` CSS rules.

## Technical Specifications

- **Performance**: 100% Lighthouse score, zero external render-blocking assets, zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS = 0.000).
- **Privacy & Security**: 100% in-browser memory execution. No user essays, homework assignments, or documents are transmitted to remote servers.
- **Accessibility**: Full WCAG AAA color contrast, semantic form element labels, and a well-formed accessibility tree compliant with Agentic Browsing standards.
